source_title: Lectric eBikes Launches Upgraded XP Lite3, Holding Original $799 Price Point - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Third-generation lightweight ebike introduces integrated turn signals, quick-release pedals, a 3.5-inch full-color display, reinforced folding latch, and new colorsâall starting at the same accessible price point established at its 2022 launch.
PHOENIX , Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lectric eBikes, the best-selling ebike company in America, today announced the official launch of the XP Lite3, the third generation of its lightweight, portable, and affordable folding ebike. Designed around the core philosophy that riding an ebike should feel effortless from start to finish, the XP Lite3 packs a suite of feature upgrades while keeping its starting price at $799âthe exact same starting price as both the previous XP Lite2 and the original XP Lite launched in 2022.
"When we saw how much our community loved the XP Lite, we made a commitment to pack in every upgrade riders asked for without raising the entry price," said Lectric eBikes co-founder and CEO Levi Conlow. "With inflation pushing costs up since 2022, a bike like this could easily be priced around $920 today. Instead, we worked hard to find efficiencies so we could deliver a superior ride while keeping our original $799 price tag intact."
At just 49 lbs., the XP Lite3 removes everyday friction for commuters, students, and RV enthusiasts alike, whether heading into a trunk, onto a train, or up an apartment staircase. It delivers speeds up to 20 mph* and offers up to 80 miles of range.
NEW Integrated Rear Turn Signals: Enhances safety and visibility on busy streets.
NEW Bright 3.5-Inch Full-Color Display: First featured on the XP4, providing clear ride data at a glance.
NEW Quick-Release Pedals: Easy to remove for an even smaller storage footprint while the bike is folded.
NEW Reinforced Folding Latch: Upgraded design (first featured on XP4) for maximum durability and strength.
NEW LevelUp Lite Rack: Offers versatile new cargo mounting possibilities.
Enhanced Stopping Power & Ergonomics: Features Star Union 602 hydraulic brakes with thicker 2.3-millimeter rotors, lock-on grips paired with a twist throttle (a first for Lectric), and a redesigned frame with improved riding ergonomics a streamlined silhouette.
Smooth Power Delivery: Five pedal-assist modes powered by Lectric's Stealth M24 motor.
Momentum Without Maintenance: Gates Carbon Belt Drive
Riders seeking a clean, low-maintenance ride can upgrade to the optional Gates Carbon Belt Drive. Eliminating the traditional bike chain, the belt drive system provides a smooth, quiet ride without requiring grease or rust management.
The XP Lite3 launches in a refreshed palette designed for every rider's style:
Standard Chain Drive: Blue Mist (New) , Matte Grey (New) , Matte Lavender (New) , and Arctic White.
Gates Carbon Belt Drive Edition: Ballerina Pink (New) and JW Black.
The Lectric XP Lite3 is available starting at $799 at LectriceBikes.com .
Lectric eBikes is the #1 best-selling ebike company in the United States. The company is known for its dedication to producing quality products at affordable prices.
